quest.title: Will of Stone
quest.description: Millelith soldier Jiayi wants to send a gift to his daughter, Little Liu, but he has no time to return to Qingce Village, and as such is looking for someone to help him out...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x7, Qingce Stir Fry x5

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Oh, where has that child run off to...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can I ask about Little Liu?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Are you looking for her? *sigh* What perfectly terrible timing. I don't know where's she's gone.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: She received a letter that her father asked someone to send over from Liyue Harbor that stated that he'd be back soon.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Little Liu was so happy. She said she wanted to prepare a gift for her father, and roped some other children into picking fruits and flowers...

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: But a few days afterward, he sent word, saying that he had a last-minute assignment and wouldn't be able to return.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: She threw a tantrum, and nothing we said could dissuade her from insisting that she would go to Liyue Harbor herself, since her father wasn't coming.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: We thought it a joke for a while. But this morning, she was gone.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: *sigh* We've already sent people out to look for her, but if you're willing, you can join in as well.

response.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
response.text: I apologize for the trouble. *sigh* This child...

choices.text: Where do you think she's headed?

response.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
response.text: I doubt she could go far. She's probably still close by, but the wilds are a dangerous place... Please, find her quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: *sigh* I was counting down the days before I'd be able to go back. Just two or three days more...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: With all the leave I've saved up until this point, I could have spent over a week together with Little Liu.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: But with but one order, all our leaves were canceled. Even the people on leave were recalled.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: In my experience, this means at least another month without any hope of returning to Qingce Village. What terrible luck...

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: Are you here to catch me and take me back to Qingce Village?

choices.text: Granny Ruoxin is worried sick about you.

response.speaker: Little Liu
response.text: Hmph. So you are here to catch me. Well, I'm not going back.

response.speaker: Little Liu
response.text: Go back and tell the villagers that I'm going to Liyue Harbor to look for Daddy.

response.speaker: Little Liu
response.text: They don't have to worry. Once I find him, I'll just talk to him for a while, then I'll come back.

response.speaker: Little Liu
response.text: I don't need anything from you. You're just trying to bribe me.

talks.objective: Catch up to Little Liu (if she gets more than 30m away, the quest will be failed)

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: That Jiayi, too. How could he just cancel on his daughter like that...

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: She doesn't see him any more than a few times a year. Is this how a father should behave?

choices.text: He's doing this for Liyue Harbor...

response.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
response.text: That's what he says every year. I've lost count of the number of times he's said that...

response.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
response.text: Well, it's also his job to take care of his daughter. Little Liu is growing up day by day.

response.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
response.text: If he's not careful, she'll be the one going out to work by the time he returns.

response.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
response.text: This father and his daughter just can't get together, can they?

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: What are you following me for, anyway? I said, I'm going to Liyue Harbor!

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: I'll get around these monsters myself. They won't find me.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: Don't treat me like a kid! I'm a grown-up now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is from your father...

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: From Daddy? Did he ask you to send it over...

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: I'm sure it's more things for children to play with... if it's not kites, it's dolls.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You don't like them?

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: ...I do. It's something Daddy gave me. How could I not like it?

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: But if I always like these things, doesn't that mean that I'll always be a kid?

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: If I keep playing with them, when will I become an adventurer, or get my own Vision?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What did you want a Vision for, again?

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: If I had a Vision, I'd be able to do so many things, whether it be making money or something else...

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: Then, Daddy wouldn't have to work in Liyue Harbor all the time. He could come back and spend time with me.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: Right now, I can't even go to Liyue Harbor myself without a Vision...

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: But since Daddy has already sent you here with his presents, I might just be giving him more trouble by going to look for him.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>I had presents ready for him too</color>. I wanted to give him a surprise... But I can't take them to him now.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>If only someone could help me do that</color>... It's alright. I'm going back. There's no need to follow me, I know the way home.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: Dolls... kites... pinwheels. Daddy sent these again, just like I thought.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's just a shame that I wasn't able to send him my gifts too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll take them to your father.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: You'll help me? Well... Even though you don't have a Vision either, it looked like those monsters didn't give you a hard time at all.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: I guess we'll have to do it this way, then. Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only I could be as strong as you...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Have you handed the presents to Little Liu yet?

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: That's good. Those toys are her favorite. Thank you — please take these as a token of my thanks.

choices.text: She'd prefer it if you were home.

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: I want to go back too. But with Liyue Harbor in this state, I don't think that's possible for the time being.

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: Still, thank you so much. I hope those presents will improve her mood a bit — they are her favorites, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Have you handed the presents to Little Liu yet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, this is from Little Liu.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: This... is from Little Liu, for me? So many... How much work did she have to put in...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: I want nothing more than to drop everything and run back to Qingce Village right now. But the Ministry of Civil Affairs would...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Thank you once again. Take these as thanks, please.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: *sigh* I have no idea when this whole affair will be over, or when the Ministry will approve my leave, either...

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: You've returned. Thank you for your help. Little Liu has already returned, and with quite the bag of things, too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Jiayi sent them to her.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Did he, now... But still, what Little Liu really wants is for him to come back in person.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: That child really has grown up like the bamboo around the village. Blink, and you'll miss just how much she's grown.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: The days when your child is young will never return again once you miss them...

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: If only I had a Vision! With it, I could do so many things, whether it's making money or whatever...

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: At least, I would have no trouble making it to Liyue on my own.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: But, how do I get my hands on one...
